AR219
Introduction to Field Archaeology
1.0 Credit
- Summer session
Hours per week:
Lab: 3
Participation in the fieldwork of an archaeological expedition. The
student
will take part in the educational
program
of the expedition, including its orientation program, lectures, seminars and field trips, and will gain practical experience of the basics of field technique and interpretive method. (Field course)
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Permission of the department.
Exclusions
AR306*.
